items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: So this is just an extension of what had been done. I'm taking you down the line now, you know, from Frankie Trumbauer, Lester, Stan Getz, and so forth. See, this is -- So they should really -- I mean go and listen to what is -- to some of the older musicians, what have been

ctx.x: I heard records of them, I didn't hear them in person. I heard Putney Dandridge, but these records, if you listen you'll see how much they contributed and how similar some of the things they're doing -- they were doing then are to the things that the guys are doing today. You know. And saxophone, like Lester Young was different, but he always reminded me of a guy that played with Paul Whiteman, Frankie Trombar. And then talking to him in later years he was influenced by Frankie Trumbauer, he told me. You know.…
And did Lester mention any other influences besides Frankie Trombar?
